payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the image visibly appear as a completed pencil drawing?
node.criteria: Compose all supports explicitly. Complete only when s3 passes, establishing that the image as a whole reads as a pencil drawing. Partial when s1 or s2 establishes requested progress and s3 fails, establishing that the whole-image result does not read as a completed pencil drawing. Absent only when s1 and s2 both fail with sufficient evidence of no requested progress. Return unknown when evidence needed to establish progress or distinguish completion from partial is unresolved; an unknown s3 is not evidence of incompleteness. A pass on s1 or s2 alone does not establish completion. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
